event: Sicomines agreement signed: 68% China (Sinohydro, China Railway) / 32% Gecamines
Freeport-McMoRan announces the sale of TFM to CMOC
CMOC completes the buyout of 56% of Tenke Fungurume from Freeport for $2.65bn
Peak episode of the Congo Hold-up scheme: a $2.5m cash withdrawal from CCC's BGFIBank account
Zongo II hydropower plant opens (150 MW)
CMOC consolidates 80% of TFM by buying out BHR Partners' stake
CMOC buys Kisanfu from Freeport-McMoRan for $550m
CATL enters Kisanfu - 25% for $137.5m
The Congo Hold-up investigation is published (PPLAAF/Mediapart/The Sentry/EIC)
DRC blocks exports from TFM for nearly a year in a royalty dispute
IGF audit published: $822m in infrastructure versus ~$10bn in Chinese profit
DRC revokes AVZ Minerals' permit for Manono, transferring the asset to a Zijin-linked structure
CMOC agrees to pay Gecamines $800m in compensation over TFM
Busanga hydropower plant commissioned (240 MW)
DRC announces completion of the first round of Sicomines talks
Amendment No. 5 to Sicomines signed: infrastructure commitment raised to $7bn
Financial close of the Nzilo II / 'Heshima' project (CMOC + Lualaba Power)
The ICC awards AVZ Minerals EUR39.1m from Cominiere
DRC imposes a ban on cobalt exports (ARECOMS)
M23 captures Goma and Bukavu
DRC formally proposes a 'minerals for security' deal to the US
Erik Prince's (FSG) contract with the DRC Ministry of Finance (~$700m)
AVZ-KoBold Metals framework agreement (~$1bn) brokered by the US
DRC and Rwanda foreign ministers sign a peace declaration in Washington
AVZ resumes ICSID arbitration against the DRC
The cobalt export ban is replaced by a quota system: 96,600 t/year for 2026-2027
CMOC announces a $1.08bn investment in Kisanfu's second phase
The Washington Accords plus the US-DRC Strategic Partnership are signed by Tshisekedi and Kagame
Congolese lawyers file a constitutional challenge against the US agreement
Erik Prince's contractors provide combat support to DRC forces near Uvira
A new comprehensive Sicomines audit (2008-2024) is launched, with Mayer Brown as counsel
Virtus Minerals (US) signs the first 'minerals for access' deal (the Mutoshi deposit)
China and DRC sign a police cooperation agreement in Beijing (Shabani-Wang Xiaohong)
The Zijin/Cominiere JV begins the first lithium production at Manono
DRC's customs platform fails: $1.1bn in cobalt exports (20,000 t) put at risk
